item.title: Arizona's taps won't run dry, but water bills will go up under federal plan for Colorado River
item.description: New federal rules mean Arizona will be getting a lot less water from the Colorado river. City leaders say they've been planning for years and no one will run out, but keeping taps flowing is expensive.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Families of pilgrims likely caught in floods are desperate for news from Nepal
item.description: Four days after catastrophic floods wiped out villages along the Nepal-China border, thousands are still missing. Families look for answers but hear nothing.

item.title: Canada claps back at Trump's efforts to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America'
item.description: Ontario Premier Doug Ford has unveiled a giant billboard reading: "Lake Ontario — Now and Always." But tech giant Google has said it is renaming the lake for U.S. users, as President Trump demanded.

item.title: Are you sure that Kimmel clip was real? Late-night AI deepfakes are spreading online
item.description: While social media is rife with AI celebrity deepfakes, videos featuring late night TV hosts like Jimmy Kimmel and Jon Stewart are are easier to create than other kinds of deepfakes and potentially more disruptive.

item.description: Dolly Parton's songs traveled far beyond Nashville. Across Africa, musicians embraced her stories of hardship, heartbreak and humble beginnings — and made them their own.

item.title: Nepal warns of possible fresh flooding as communities grapple with devastation
item.description: Authorities in Nepal warned of possible fresh flooding on Sunday and urged residents in flood-affected districts to remain on high alert after water levels rose in the Bhotekoshi River.

item.title: Medicare's pilot GLP-1 discount program has a catch. Some sick patients don't qualify
item.description: Medicare launched a pilot program that could streamline the process to get GLP-1s, with some seniors paying just $50 a month. But many people with the most serious illnesses won't get that discount.
